_comment: Default pathway per recommendation route, created for every active qualification that lacks one. {qualification} is replaced with the qualification name. Seeding never overwrites a pathway an administrator has edited.

TRAINING_AND_ASSESSMENT.title: Train, then get assessed
TRAINING_AND_ASSESSMENT.description: For learners new to {qualification}: complete a training program, confirm you are ready, then take the national competency assessment.

steps.title: Enroll in a {qualification} training program
steps.description: Choose a TESDA-registered program near you or online.

steps.title: Complete the readiness check
steps.description: Rate yourself on each competency to find any remaining gaps.

steps.title: Apply for the competency assessment
steps.description: Book a schedule at an accredited assessment center.

steps.title: Receive your National Certificate
steps.description: Candidates assessed as competent are issued a National Certificate.

ASSESSMENT_READINESS.title: Turn your experience into a certificate
ASSESSMENT_READINESS.description: Your work experience may already cover {qualification}. Check your readiness, review any gaps, then go straight to assessment.

steps.title: Complete the readiness check
steps.description: Confirm which competencies your experience already covers.

steps.title: Review the competencies you marked as gaps
steps.description: Take short refresher training only where you need it.

steps.title: Apply for the competency assessment
steps.description: Book a schedule at an accredited assessment center.

steps.title: Receive your National Certificate
steps.description: Candidates assessed as competent are issued a National Certificate.

SKILL_GAP_CHECK.title: Close your skill gaps
SKILL_GAP_CHECK.description: Use your existing experience or certificate as a base and train only on the {qualification} competencies you still need.

steps.title: Complete the readiness check
steps.description: Find the competencies you still need to build.

steps.title: Take focused training on your gaps
steps.description: Pick modules or programs that cover the competencies you marked as gaps.

steps.title: Check your readiness again
steps.description: Confirm you are ready before booking an assessment.

steps.title: Apply for the competency assessment
steps.description: Book a schedule at an accredited assessment center.
